notes.title: 🌱 Growing Bigger: Land Expansion Update!
notes.content:
[p]Another week, another update! 😄[/p][p]
This time I’ve been working on the [b]land expansion system[/b], it’s now in place, though I’m still polishing and fine-tuning the details.

[/p][p]What’s next:

I’ll be wrapping up the land expansion and then moving on to [b]refactoring and polishing the building system[/b] to make it as smooth and enjoyable as possible!

[/p][p]📌 Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, join our Discord community, and follow the weekly devlogs![/p][p]See you next week! 👋[/p]
